text:
Miri (Product): quick sync — we need to decide priority lanes for the next sprint. two customer-driven pilots landed at once: Vega wants BYOK+prewarm, Ion wants tenant isolation + edge caching. both ask for private onramp. we can't do both fully parallel. need sequencing and owners.
Omar (PM): timeline ask: Vega pilot in 4w, Ion in 6w. product preference is to deliver Vega earlier because their contract has a revenue milestone. but Ion is broader product signal for tenant isolation.
Luca (Runtime): runtime constraints: BYOK integration is mostly config + key fetch path; prewarm requires a small runtime hook and warm-health endpoint. tenant isolation requires KV namespaces and more intrusive routing changes. BYOK+prewarm is narrower surface area.
Priya (Infra): infra note: both require VPC peering and reserved GPU quotas. Quota approvals are likely the longest lead (~5-8bd). we can reuse the same peering and reserved pool for both pilots if we sequence them within the same account. provisioning a separate tenant namespace for Ion is additional infra work.
Hana (Security): security callout: BYOK has higher compliance gate — we need vendor attestation + key rotation policy. that review is a serial blocker for any peering that allows egress to customer KMS. estimate 7bd after packet. tenant isolation has lower compliance risk but more surface area to audit.
Ethan (Eng): engineering estimate: BYOK + prewarm = ~2.5w focused runtime work + tests. tenant isolation = ~4w, more tests and dashboard changes. given that, sequence BYOK pilot first to hit Vega timeline.
Sam (SRE): operational requirements: for both pilots we need per-tenant SLOs, synthetic cold-start probes, and routing fallback policies. SRE can standardize the canary playbook and reuse it across both pilots.
Miri (Product): proposed plan: 1) fast-track Vega (BYOK+prewarm) in sprint A — parallelize security packet + infra quota request; runtime/eng spike mocked KMS now. 2) start Ion runway in sprint B using learnings and reuse infra peering + quota. decision point mid-sprint A to commit sprint B scope.
Omar (PM): risk: if vendor attestation for Vega stalls, that serial blocker blocks peering and delays everything. contingency: we can run a hosted BYOK shim to validate prewarm and routing without customer KMS egress. that'll satisfy some acceptance tests but not BYOK final signoff.
Hana (Security): agree on hosted shim contingency. I'll start the attestation checklist immediately once Vega provides vendor docs. request Vega to include SOC2 and key rotation details.
Priya (Infra): infra action: open quota + peering ticket, request reserved GPU headroom. if Vega agrees to reuse the pool for Ion, note that in the ticket to avoid duplicate approvals.
Luca (Runtime): i'll post a short design for prewarm endpoint and warm-health metric: GET /tenant/<id>/warm -> warm:true|false, kv_prefetch:percent. routing can use kv_prefetch > 90% to allow traffic.
Ethan (Eng): i'll add a feature flag for BYOK path and a CI test that swaps in the hosted shim. tests can run before security approval.
Sam (SRE): suggested rollout: canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% with p99 checks. rollback policy: if p99 baseline delta > 25% for 10m, auto-route affected tenants to hosted fallback and page oncall.
Miri (Product): action items recap: 1) Hana: start attestation review for Vega when packet arrives (due 7bd). 2) Priya: open INFRA-VEGA-900 quota + peering ticket (due 3bd). 3) Luca/Ethan: spike prewarm + hosted shim RFC (deliverable: design link by EOW). 4) Sam: canary & rollback playbook draft (2bd). 5) Omar/Miri: confirm Vega acceptance criteria and contingency for hosted shim (2bd). react with :white_check_mark: when acked.
ticket-bot: Created ticket INFRA-VEGA-900 by Priya.
Priya (Infra): ticket INFRA-VEGA-900 created and linked here. adding expected GPU count and CIDR.
Hana (Security): received ticket link; starting preliminary review.
Luca (Runtime): design posted: https://redwood.internal/designs/vega-prewarm-shim (contains health endpoint proto and fallback signals).
Ethan (Eng): RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/vega-byok-shim (tests + rollback plan).
Omar (PM): small callout — cloud quota for our org is near threshold; if INFRA team needs more headroom we should escalate to cloud-ops now.
Miri (Product): good catch. Priya, please add cloud-ops as watcher on the ticket.
Priya (Infra): added cloud-ops and tagged expedited path request.
Sam (SRE): I'll prepare the runbook template and a canary dashboard before canary. posting link tomorrow.
Miri (Product): thanks everyone. if vendor attestation completes quickly we keep sprint A focused and start Ion runway mid-sprint. if attestation stalls >5bd, we'll re-evaluate and possibly switch sprint slot. next sync Thurs 9:30 to confirm attestation and quota status. please react :thumbsup: when you've seen this.
